三重积分 $\int_{-r}^{r}dx\int_{-\sqrt{r^2-x^2}}^{\sqrt{r^2-x^2}}dy\int_0^{\sqrt{r^2-x^2-y^2}}(x^2+y^2)\,dz$ 的值为（ ） $\frac4{15}\pi r^5$ $\frac45\pi r^5$ $\frac4{15}\pi r^3$ $\frac1{15}\pi r^3$ $\int_{-r}^{r}dx\int_{-\sqrt{r^2-x^2}}^{\sqrt{r^2-x^2}}dy\int_0^{\sqrt{r^2-x^2-y^2}}(x^2+y^2)\,dz$

$=\iint_{x^2+y^2\leq r^2}dxdy\int_0^{\sqrt{r^2-x^2-y^2}}(x^2+y^2)\,dz$

$=\iint_{x^2+y^2\leq r^2}\sqrt{r^2-x^2-y^2}(x^2+y^2)\,dxdy$

$=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^r\rho^2\sqrt{r^2-\rho^2}\rho\,d\rho$

$=2\pi r^5\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\sin^3\theta-\sin^5\theta)\,d\theta$

$=\frac{4}{15}\pi r^5$。
